1.title: Trump Calls A.I. Fears a Hoax. Inside the White House, the Debate Is More Complex.
1.summary: The president seems driven chiefly by the sense that A.I. is the way to economic growth, and nothing can be allowed to stand in its way.

2.title: How Trump Became an A.I. Evangelist
2.summary: President Trump had little interest in artificial intelligence until a fateful meeting in Las Vegas two years ago. Now, Mr. Trump sees A.I. as the defining technology of our age. Our White House correspondent Jonathan Swan tracks Trump’s journey to A.I. evangelist.

3.title: Ocasio-Cortez Donates to N.Y. Democrats, Will Barnstorm State Ahead of Midterms
3.summary: The news comes amid speculation about whether Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, the Democratic Socialist from the Bronx, is considering a run for senator or president.

4.title: F.B.I. Temporarily Halted Cooperation With Canada Over References to 9/11
4.summary: The abrupt move by Kash Patel, the bureau’s director, came as President Trump was ramping up his attacks on the country.

5.title: Dozens of suspected illegal miners die in Nigerian custody
5.summary: Authorities linked the deaths to disease, but this has been disputed by intelligence reports and relatives of the accused.

6.title: 37 Miners in Nigeria Die in Police Custody, Sparking Protests
6.summary: One survivor told The New York Times that dozens were packed into a single cell with barely any ventilation, food, or water.
